sights.n: Sapporo Salmon Museum (札幌市豊平川さけ科学館)
sights.address: Makomanai Kōen 2-1, Minami-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: A free museum in Makomanai Park with tanks of some 20 salmonid species (including the giant itō) and outdoor pools where wild salmon spawn each autumn.
sources: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/札幌市豊平川さけ科学館

sights.n: Sapporo Science Center (札幌市青少年科学館)
sights.w: A hands-on 'see, touch, think' science museum by Shin-Sapporo Station, with Hokkaido's largest planetarium.
